title: M. Antonius
summary: Raleigh names M. Antonius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). M. Antonius, who with Crassus suffered thirst in the Parthian expeditions. He is not the Antonius who giues Zoan the name Thanis. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIX, §. VII, sig. 313b–314a
